source.product: MCD12Q2 v061 Land Cover Dynamics (MODIS Terra+Aqua), 500 m, yearly
source.via: ORNL DAAC MODIS/VIIRS Land Product Subsets (TESViS) REST API

encoding: pxDelta = pixel index differences (cumulative sum gives row-major index, r = floor(i / ncols), c = i % ncols); doy = day of year of season end, same order

rule.note: Season end = Dormancy of the first cycle of the year (EVI2 back to 15 % of its amplitude), QA_Overall <= 2, amplitude >= 0.15, end between 1 April and 31 July (spring-ending seasons: mostly winter wheat, also early vegetables). Pixels whose first cycle ends later (cotton, second crops) are not in this map. 500 m pixel; crop identity is not known per pixel.
rule.rejected: An "early crop (onion) area" count (first cycle ending by 15 May) was tested and rejected: it gave 4649 (2016), 179 (2017), 1 (2018), 5068 (2019), 1853 (2020), 233 (2022) pixels - the tail of the wheat distribution in warm springs, not onion fields. 500 m pixels cannot separate 1-5 ha onion fields; that needs 10-30 m imagery (HLS/Sentinel-2) and a field map.
